text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems Loves Only You is agonizing over 
which racing outfit to wear for the main 
event until the very last minute. Which 
one will she choose in the end?"
choice_data_list:
I'd say we've walked side by side all this 
time.

Probably the one packed with determination 
for the BC.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will take that Racewear to the BC, 
imbued with the feelings forged together 
with her fans and best friend.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da♪ I decided to go with this one♡ It's 
packed with all the time we've spent 
walking together. With the love dwelling 
in this as my strength, I'll definitely 
win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will race in the racing silks born 
from her best friend's feelings, infused 
with a renewed resolve for the BC.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da♪ I decided to go with this one~! Our 
love that we'll deliver to the world... 
There's no other choice but to wear the 
racing outfit imbued with those feelings 
right here, right?♡
